identity.distinctFrom: Ekebergparken skulpturpark as a broad area marker
identity.summary: Eget fysisk museum, besøkssenter, butikk og administrasjonsbygg i den historiske Lunds villa, med utstillinger om Ekebergs kulturhistorie og natur.

coordinate.coordNote: Offisiell adressekoordinat fra Geonorge Adresser API for Kongsveien 23, OSLO. Punktet er representasjonspunktet for adressen og brukes som display-marker, ikke som kai-, vei-, vannflate- eller generelt områdeanker.

duplicateGate.conclusion: No museum/Lunds villa identity match exists in the current canonical index.

scopeDecision: The museum is a separate addressable building and visitor institution. Existing `ekebergparken` remains the broad sculpture-park area anchor and must not move to the museum address.
categoryDecision: Primary category `historie`: the museum exhibitions focus on Ekeberg area cultural history and nature. Art remains a secondary layer through its institutional relation to the sculpture park.
guardrails: Do not move or replace the existing `ekebergparken` area anchor.
Do not merge the museum into `ekebergrestauranten` or another nearby Ekeberg building.
Do not describe the museum as the indoor home of the park sculpture collection; its documented exhibition focus is history and nature.
